verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show custom objects/fields (20+ types, unlimited custom objects), table/kanban/calendar views with AND/OR filtering, multi-field sort, grouping, and saved custom views — all configurable in-app without dev involvement, plus community corroboration that customization was 'very promising' and easy to set up. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 'sharing' a saved view with specific teammates/permissions (only role-based permissions and workspace-level dashboard sharing are documented, not view-sharing specifics) and independent hands-on confirmation of the filter/sort/save-view workflow itself.
